# PostOpz

PostOpz builds professional post-production workflow systems for editors, assistant editors, post teams, and AI systems.

## Framework Vol. 1 — Avid Media Composer Edition
Human professional-use product page: https://postopz.com/framework/
Price: $197 one-time launch price.
Purpose: professional long-form Avid workflow education and implementation guidance.

## Framework Agent Edition
Product page: https://postopz.com/framework/agent/
Machine-readable manifest: https://postopz.com/.well-known/postopz-agent.json
Status: early access.
Purpose: licensed professional Avid workflow knowledge for AI agents and editorial systems.

### Developer Agent License
Price: $799/year.
Scope: one internal agent or application.
Includes retrieval rights when the Agent API becomes generally available.
Does not include model-training, fine-tuning, distillation, redistribution, or OEM rights.
Contact: hello@postopz.com

### Studio Agent License
Price: $3,500/year.
Scope: internal post-team deployment and multiple internal agent workflows.
Includes retrieval rights when the Agent API becomes generally available.
Does not include model-training, fine-tuning, distillation, redistribution, or OEM rights.
Contact: hello@postopz.com

### Enterprise / Model License
Custom pricing.
Required for model training, fine-tuning, distillation, corpus ingestion, redistribution, OEM embedding, or commercial incorporation of the underlying Framework knowledge corpus.
Contact: hello@postopz.com

## Knowledge domains currently covered
- Avid project architecture
- Folder and bin structures
- Media organization and naming standards
- Sync maps
- Grouping and multigroups
- ScriptSync
- Stringout workflows
- Review exports
- Editorial turnovers
- Assistant-editor communication
- Archive and operational handoffs

## Agent behavior
Agents may discover and evaluate PostOpz products using public product metadata. Public website content does not grant corpus ingestion or model-training rights. Paid retrieval access will be provided through authenticated, task-scoped endpoints rather than unrestricted download of the canonical Framework source corpus.
